# What does your hay cost to make, and which bale type pays best?

> Free hay pricing calculator for hay producers: compare small squares, large squares and round bales on net profit per ton and per acre, with break-even price per bale. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/hay-sale-price-calculator/)
